verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs say the server installs via Docker or pip, ships a standard docker-compose.yml, and can be self-hosted on consumer hardware. A hands-on community report contradicts this: the docker build failed on a pyside6 dependency and pip install exited with code 1. Chat may also need extra setup, such as model API keys. Missing for 10: a documented single-command install, evidence of reaching a working chat within minutes, and independent confirmation that Docker/pip installs succeed.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes

citations.quote: You can install the Khoj server using either Docker or Pip.
If you're using Docker, online search should work out of the box with searxng using our standard docker-compose.yml.
You can self-host on consumer hardware for privacy
